answer: Priced Deferred Identity Commitments: each new identity posts a small deposit that unlocks only after a fixed delay, and coordination within that window pays a rising premium drawn from a shared nebula of pooled deposits. An attacker seeding many identities must fund every deposit upfront and forfeit the premium each time, so the per-identity cost scales with how many act together rather than staying flat. Honest users absorb the delay as a thread of waiting, while duplicate accounts burn an ember of capital that never returns.
